queue.searchHint: Type or scan a full request number and press Enter to open it.
queue.partial: Only the first {{shown}} are loaded; search for the rest
queue.noMatchBody: Try another number, name or medicine, or clear the filters.

emptyBody.all: Refill bookings and renewals a doctor agreed to appear here.
emptyBody.check: New refill bookings and freshly approved renewals come here first.
emptyBody.ready: Requests move here after "Prepared"; the patient is notified at the same time.
emptyBody.returned: Returned requests stay here until the patient or the doctor acts.
emptyBody.done: Requests collected today are listed here.

dispense.title: Check and dispense
dispense.noCard: This prescription is not in the patient's medicine list
dispense.checkedNote: A program compared the patient's answers and the prescription dates with fixed rules. No AI judged this, and it is not an approval.
dispense.question: Question
dispense.leftOutNote: Items the doctor did not agree to renew
dispense.closed: This request is closed and can only be read.

origin.title: Where this comes from
origin.refill: The rules confirmed the refill window. The prescription was issued by the clinic, so this fill needs no new decision by a doctor.
origin.renewal: Checked by rules, decided by {{name}} ({{at}}). You can still return it or ask the doctor.
origin.undecided: Checked by rules. The doctor has not decided, so it cannot be dispensed.

check.title: Four checks
check.identity: Ask for the NHI card and match the name "{{name}}". The system does not read the card.
check.allergyNone: No allergy on record. Ask in person.
check.allergy: On record: {{list}}. Compare with what is being handed over.
check.interaction: Compare with {{count}} other medicine(s). The system does not judge interactions and is not connected to NHI MediCloud.
check.interactionSame: Compare with {{count}} other medicine(s); same class: {{list}}. The system does not judge interactions and is not connected to NHI MediCloud.
check.quantityUnknown: {{drug}}: no day count on record, use the original prescription
check.early: You can tick these while preparing. Ticks stay in this tab and are sent with the hand-over.
check.left_one: {{count}} check left before you can confirm the hand-over.
check.left_other: {{count}} checks left before you can confirm the hand-over.
check.refusedNext: Return it with a reason, or ask the doctor.

state.submitted: Just sent by the patient. Nobody has it yet.
state.approved: The doctor agreed. Nobody has it yet.
state.partially_approved: The doctor agreed to some items. Nobody has it yet.
state.new: Decided by the doctor. No pharmacist has it yet.
state.mine: You are preparing this. The patient is notified when it is ready.
state.other: {{name}} is preparing this. You can continue; your name is recorded.
state.ready: Prepared, and the patient has been told. Finish the four checks before handing over.
state.returned: Returned. Waiting for the patient to send it again or for the doctor.
state.in_review: With the doctor. It comes back to be checked after the decision.
state.more_info: The doctor asked the patient for more, so it cannot be dispensed now.
state.declined: The doctor did not agree to renew, so it cannot be dispensed.
state.visit_required: The doctor asked for a visit, so it cannot be dispensed.
state.closed: Nothing for the pharmacy to do right now.

stale.title: This request was just updated
stale.body: The latest version is loaded and is now "{{status}}". Your action was not sent; read it and try again.

ask.missing: Write a reason so they know what to do.

return.title: Return {{no}}
return.body: The request leaves the dispensing queue and the patient is notified.
return.label: Reason
return.hint: The patient can read this. Say what is wrong and whom to contact.

ask_physician.title: Ask the doctor about {{no}}
ask_physician.body: The request goes back to the doctor's review list with priority.
ask_physician.label: What to confirm
ask_physician.hint: Staff only. Name the medicine, the doubt, and what you need answered.

thread.title: Messages
thread.label: Message
thread.hintStaff: Doctors, coordinators and pharmacists can read it. The patient cannot.
thread.hintAll: The patient is notified and reads the full text. For anything urgent, phone.

patient.title: Patient medicines
patient.noAllergyBody: No record does not mean no allergy. Ask before handing over.
patient.noOthers: No other medicine on the list
patient.selfReportedNote: Entered by the patient. There is no clinic prescription, so it cannot be refilled or renewed here.
patient.logged: Opening this page is logged. The patient sees it under Privacy and data.
patient.limitBody: Medicines, allergies and requests. Previsit conversations, history, readings, notes and appointments are outside the pharmacist's permissions.

history.title: Dispensing history
history.lede: Requests that left the counter: collected, returned, sent to a doctor, cancelled.
history.inReviewNote: Includes every request a doctor is reviewing.

formulary.title: Medicine scope
formulary.lede: Medicines the system knows, whether a renewal can be requested online, and why. The scope lives in a data file; this page is read only.
formulary.caption: Medicine scope list
formulary.noneBody: Try another name or clear the filters. Medicines that are not listed cannot be requested online.
formulary.noVerified: This data came without a check date.
formulary.notAdvice: This list only decides which path a request takes. It is not treatment advice and not an NHI coverage rule.

rules.title: Rules
rules.lede: The checks a request passes before it reaches the counter. Read only: changing a rule means changing a data file and deploying.
rules.refillLede: A program works out the second and third fill from these numbers. The model is not involved.
rules.redLede: {{count}} rules. Every patient message and every text in a request passes them before the model sees it. A hit shows the fixed emergency text and opens an urgent ticket.
rules.scopeLede: {{count}} rules. Requests for prescriptions, dose changes or controlled drugs, and attempts to change the system's rules, get a fixed answer from the program.
rules.protocolLede: Protocol {{version}}, {{classes}} classes. Each rule only decides what the doctor sees and where the request is placed.
rules.rulesNotSent: This data has the questions but not the conditions. They are in data/seed/renewal_protocols.json.
rules.generalNote: Every renewal starts with the general questions, then the questions of its class.
rules.question: Question
rules.noQuestions: No extra questions for this class

print.label: Medicine-bag label
print.labelNote: Demonstration only. Laid out like a medicine bag; real labels come from the pharmacy's own system.
print.slipNote: Demonstration only. For the patient to keep; it says nothing about the condition.
print.missingList: Quantity, indication, side effects, warnings. Use the original prescription and leaflet.
print.labelFoot: Fictional person and prescription. Not for real dispensing.
print.bringBody: NHI card and the original refillable prescription. To collect for someone else, bring their NHI card.
print.slipFoot: Demonstration slip with a fictional person and pharmacy. The system shows the actual progress.

self.settingsLede: Your own account, display, password and signed-in devices.
self.mustChangeBody: The password from the administrator is for the first sign-in only. Set your own below.
self.title: Title
self.name: Display name
self.nameHint: What patients and colleagues see. Role and title are set by an administrator.
self.languageHint: Rules and notifications change to this language too.
self.textHint: Scales the whole interface and follows your account.
self.nextHint: At least 8 characters, not used on other sites.
self.passwordSaved: Password changed; other devices are signed out
self.devicesNote: Sign out a device you don't recognise, then change the password.
self.revokeBody: That device leaves the system at once; unsaved work may be lost.
